title: 第13章 圣火传承第14章 白昕儿
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: 叶峰闻言，也知道徐墨说的很有道理，可是他就是不甘心啊！
同时他也被徐墨最后的话，吓出了一身冷汗。
是啊，他现在只是合欢圣地的普通弟子，而徐墨可是合欢圣地唯一的圣子，他跟徐墨的身份有着天地之差，虽说他有师尊林清音保护。
但是合欢圣地内可是有好几个圣人的，徐墨的母亲合欢圣主更是圣王级别的超级强者，现在的他根本不是对手。
要是徐墨真的借这件事，对他发难，那……
等等！
徐墨不是如烟妹妹的舔狗嘛，我只要把如烟妹妹搬出来，他肯定不会为难我，甚至还可能把万古钟让给我！
想到这里，叶峰顿时眼中一亮，随即抬头对上徐墨的目光，“徐墨，这万古钟对我真的很重要。
我希望你能把它让给我，你身为圣地圣子，应该也不差这一件圣器吧？
再说了，你不让给我的话，我就让……”
“哦？你就让什么？”
徐墨双眼微眯，有些好奇。
“我就让如烟妹妹再也不理你！
怕不怕！”
叶峰闻言，嘴角上扬，似乎觉得自己已经拿捏住了徐墨。
其实这等算不上威胁的威胁，对于其他人来说或许不值一提，但是叶峰知道，徐墨可是一个大舔狗啊！
就连自己每个月的修炼资源和那珍贵无比的圣丹，都可以毫不犹豫地交给如烟妹妹，这一个万古钟，想来也是没问题的！
然后让叶峰没想到的是，徐墨听完不仅没有答应，反而笑出了声。
噗呲～
“你笑什么！”
叶峰有些摸不着头脑。
我当然是笑你这个草原人啊！
徐墨也属实没想到，他都和柳如烟一起进出房间好多次了。
这叶峰竟然没有丝毫察觉和怀疑，还以为柳如烟是清白之身，他是以前的舔狗呢。
所以他改变了要惩罚叶峰的方法，毕竟对于他们这些顶尖气运之子来说，越是打压他，反而会使他变得更强。
就比如流放禁地或则关在某个极寒李热之地，那些地方往往会遇到各种机缘。
他可不会给叶峰这个机会，他要好好利用柳如烟，跟叶峰打心理战！
“叶师弟啊，我建议你还是回去问问她，这几天都和我发生了什么！
还有就是，别忘了提醒她明日和我的约定，而且由于你今天让我很不开心。
所以，她要是不想我定你罪，就让她明日早点来，我会在老地方等她！”
徐墨的脸上带着笑意，似乎看到了叶峰头上茂密的草原。
他现在并不怕叶峰知道自己和柳如烟发生了关系，也不怕叶峰恨自己，他反而希望叶峰知道。
毕竟，作为一个合格的反派，搞气运之子心态这种事，他是很乐意的。
说完后，不等叶峰反应，徐墨便离开了炼武场。
只留下了一脸呆滞，不知所以的叶峰在风中独自凌乱。
content_en:
When Ye Feng heard this, he also knew that what Xu Mo said was very reasonable, but he just couldn't accept it!
At the same time, he was also frightened into a cold sweat by Xu Mo's last words.
Yes, he is just an ordinary disciple of Hehuan Holy Land now, and Xu Mo is the only holy son of Hehuan Holy Land. There is a world of difference between his and Xu Mo's identities, although he is protected by his master Lin Qingyin.
But there are several saints in Hehuan Holy Land, and Xu Mo's mother, Holy Lord Hehuan, is a super strong person at the level of a holy king. Now he is no match at all.
If Xu Mo really used this incident to attack him, then...
Wait!
Isn't Xu Mo the licking dog of sister Ruyan? As long as I move sister Ruyan out, he will definitely not make things difficult for me, and he may even give me the eternal clock!
Thinking of this, Ye Feng's eyes suddenly lit up, and he immediately raised his head to meet Xu Mo's gaze, "Xu Mo, this Eternal Bell is really important to me.
I hope you can give it to me. As the Holy Son of the Holy Land, you shouldn’t be short of this sacred artifact, right?
Besides, if you don’t let me, I will…”
"Oh? What do you want?"
Xu Mo narrowed his eyes slightly, curious.
"I will tell Sister Ruyan to ignore you again!
Are you afraid? "
When Ye Feng heard this, the corners of his mouth raised, as if he felt that he had Xu Mo under control.
In fact, this kind of threat that is not a threat may not be worth mentioning to other people, but Ye Feng knows that Xu Mo is a big licker!
Even my monthly cultivation resources and the extremely precious Holy Pill can be handed over to Sister Ruyan without hesitation. This Eternal Bell is no problem!
What Ye Feng didn't expect was that Xu Mo not only didn't agree, but actually laughed out loud.
Phew~
"What are you laughing at!"
Ye Feng was a little confused.
Of course I am laughing at you, a prairie man!
Xu Mo really didn't expect that he and Liu Ruyan had been in and out of the room many times.
Ye Feng didn't even notice or suspect at all. He thought Liu Ruyan was innocent and that he was the former licking dog.
So he changed the method of punishing Ye Feng. After all, for these top fortune-telling sons, the more they suppressed him, the stronger he would become.
For example, being exiled to a forbidden place or being imprisoned in an extremely cold and hot place, those places often encounter various opportunities.
He will not give Ye Feng this opportunity. He will make good use of Liu Ruyan to fight Ye Feng's psychological warfare!
"Junior Brother Ye, I suggest you go back and ask her what happened to me these past few days!
Also, don't forget to remind her of her agreement with me tomorrow, and because you made me very unhappy today.
So, if she doesn’t want me to convict you, just ask her to come early tomorrow, and I will wait for her at the same place! "
With a smile on Xu Mo's face, he seemed to see the dense grassland above Ye Feng.
He is not afraid that Ye Feng will know that he has a relationship with Liu Ruyan, nor is he afraid that Ye Feng will hate him. Instead, he hopes that Ye Feng will know.
After all, as a qualified villain, he is very happy to engage in such things as the fate of the child.
After finishing speaking, Xu Mo left the martial arts field without waiting for Ye Feng's reaction.
Only Ye Feng, who had a dull look on his face and didn't know why, was left alone and messy in the wind.
